inputs.name: restic_version
inputs.description: restic release to install, without the leading v.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the linux_amd64 and linux_arm64 .bz2 release files, by architecture, x86_64 and aarch64, from the release's SHA256SUMS. Change these with restic_version.

inputs.name: repository
inputs.description: Repository to back up to, as restic takes it: a local path, or sftp:, rest:, s3:, b2:, azure:, gs: or rclone: followed by the location.

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: Password the repository is encrypted with. Kept out of the plan and state. Lose it and the backups can't be read.

inputs.name: environment
inputs.description: Environment variables the backend needs, such as { AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID = "...", AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY = "..." }. Kept out of the plan and state.

inputs.name: excludes
inputs.description: Patterns restic skips, one per line in an --exclude-file, such as ["/home/*/.cache", "*.tmp"].

inputs.name: schedule
inputs.description: When the backup runs, as a systemd calendar expression, such as "daily" or "*-*-* 02:30:00".

inputs.name: randomized_delay
inputs.description: Longest random delay systemd adds to each run, as a systemd time span such as "30min" or "0", so hosts on the same schedule don't all start at once.

inputs.name: retention
inputs.type:
object({
    keep_last    = optional(number)
    keep_hourly  = optional(number)
    keep_daily   = optional(number, 7)
    keep_weekly  = optional(number, 4)
    keep_monthly = optional(number, 12)
    keep_yearly  = optional(number)
  })
inputs.description: Snapshots restic forget keeps after each backup, before it prunes the rest. Null keeps every snapshot. A keep of 0 or null is left out.

inputs.name: check_schedule
inputs.description: When restic check verifies the repository, as a systemd calendar expression such as "Sun *-*-* 04:00:00". When null, it doesn't.
